recognize_zh: 四格中的嗜中性球（C、D 也見單核樣細胞）細胞質內各有一到數顆小而清楚的藍綠色折光包涵體，背景紅血球多為有規則短刺的棘狀紅血球（burr cell），偶見碎裂紅血球，符合藍綠色包涵體（「綠色死亡晶體」）。
features: Neutrophils and a monocytoid cell containing one to several small, sharply defined blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions distinct from Dohle bodies by their bright blue-green color and crisp, crystal-like outline
Leukocyte nuclei mature, segmented or band-shaped; no toxic vacuolation prominent
Numerous echinocytes (burr cells) with regular short projections in the background
Occasional fragmented red cells/schistocytes and target-like forms; platelets scarce
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, shown in four panels, demonstrates neutrophils and occasional monocytes containing small, discrete, blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions. The background red cells show numerous burr cells with occasional fragmented forms, and platelets are scarce in these fields. No intracellular organisms with defined internal structure are identified. Findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophilic and monocytic inclusions, which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and multiorgan failure and portend a poor prognosis; the clinical team should be alerted.

ddx.vs: Dohle bodies are pale gray-blue, ill-defined peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than bright blue-green, sharply outlined refractile granules.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of purple granules and bacteria are rod or coccoid with a basophilic stain, not solitary glassy blue-green crystals.
MYH9 inclusions are pale blue spindle or comma shapes accompanied by giant platelets in a chronically stable patient.
Phagocytosed pigment is golden-brown and cryoglobulin appears as amorphous pale blue material, unlike discrete emerald blue-green refractile inclusions.
